crossRefs.note: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from…
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

translations.web: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.
translations.bsb: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.
translations.kjv: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
translations.asv: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
